correctness.rationale: The Hilbert–Schmidt dissipation identity for positive gamma, kappa, J excludes nondecaying eigenmodes and warrants exact integration. A direct derivation yields four closed real equations; successive integration gives the proposed formula. Completing a square proves the unique global optimizer for s<m. Bright/dark spectral splitting determines the gamma=0 cases and positive jump. Independent full-Liouvillian inversion and numerical minimization corroborated with 326 checks, maximum abs error 2.096e-13.

value.rationale: Natural star quantum transport under hub extraction and local dephasing has an exact, coherence-controlled noise-tuning law that is independent of trap rate, resolving a physically motivated optimization for all leaf preparations. The weak-noise mean-time jump for the bright state is a substantive noncommuting-limit effect. This is not merely an isolated matrix identity or numerical table and does not claim unattained stronger results.
